name: IVR Leave System - 02 Advisor Action & Parent Notification

parameters.query: UPDATE leave_od_requests SET status = '={{ $json.body.status }}', advisor_notes = '={{ $json.body.advisorNotes }}', reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE request_id = '={{ $json.body.requestId }}' RETURNING *;
SELECT s.student_name, s.roll_no, s.parent_phone_number, s.parent_name FROM students_parent_directory s WHERE s.roll_no = '={{ $json.roll_no }}';
